notes: Copy Style / Paste Style now available in the Timeline text inspector (previously Scene view only). In Timeline layout the per-scene text is edited through the clean .tl-inspector (built by buildTimelineInspector), which replaces the Scene-view 'Main Text' accordion where the 📋 Copy Style / 📌 Paste Style buttons lived — so you couldn't copy/paste a text style while working in the timeline. Added the two buttons (.tl-styleio) into the inspector, directly under the Box/Glow/Plain style chips, styled to match the native chips. They call new dispatchers tlInspCopyStyle/tlInspPasteStyle that route by the currently selected layer (tlSelLayer): main text → reuse copySceneStyle/pasteSceneStyle (same _copiedStyle clipboard as Scene view; paste reloads via loadSegments which rebuilds the inspector); extra text layer → reuse copyExtraStyle/pasteExtraStyle, then rebuild the inspector so its swatches/size reflect the pasted style. Reuses the existing copy_style/paste_style i18n. Verified in-browser at full width: buttons render in the inspector; real button onclick fires ('✅ Copied!'); copying scene 0's distinct style (box/55/#ff3366) and pasting to scene 1 updated scene 1 to match; test scenes restored; no console errors.
